items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data without requiring administrator privileges or user interaction.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B, enabling a security-feature bypass with authentication but without administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (Admin)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, successful exploitation of which could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
